kind.description:
Kind is "authored" or "baseline". It reports PERMANENCE, not scope: the
baseline is the one set every User holds and the one that cannot be
renamed or deleted. Its membership is editable like any other set's.

member_count.description:
MemberCount is len(ModelIDs). It is NOT a count of models the caller may
use — see Unrestricted.

model_ids.description: ModelIDs are the models an admin chose, as opaque strings.

unrestricted.description:
Unrestricted means "every model the gateway serves, including ones
configured later", whatever ModelIDs says. ANY set may have this scope,
not only the baseline: an authored set granted to one group widens that
group while everyone else stays on the baseline.

A client MUST branch on it before rendering. ModelIDs is EMPTY in this
state, so ignoring the flag renders "no models" for a set that grants all
of them.

code.description:
Code is the specific machine-readable reason within Type. Optional: a
message-only error omits it.

message.description: Message is the human-readable description, safe to show to the caller.

type.description:
Type is the broad class of the error. Optional: a message-only error
omits it.
